Meta.title: Spexgram
Meta.description: Photos and videos from the spex: shows, rehearsals, parties and jubilees

Common.noDataDescription: Couldn't find any data at the moment. Please check back later.
Common.noFilterMatchDescription: Try adjusting your filters or search query to find what you're looking for.

NoAccess.title: You do not have access
NoAccess.text: Your FGV account ({email}) has no access to Spexgram. Ask an administrator for access, or log out and log in with another account.
NoAccess.notice: Your FGV account ({email}) has no access to Spexgram, so you only see what is public. Ask an administrator for access.

LoginError.title: Login failed
LoginError.text: Something went wrong while logging in. Please try again.

Forbidden.title: You do not have permission
Forbidden.text: You do not have permission to see this page. Ask a admin if you need it.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.text: The page, album or photo does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

Errors.CONFLICT: Someone else has changed this. Reload and try again.
Errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do that.
Errors.NOT_FOUND: It does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

About.title: About
About.heading: About Spexgram
About.description: Spexgram is provided by FGV and gathers photos and short videos from the spex: shows, revivals, rehearsals, parties, jubilees and tours.
About.feedbackDescription: We value your opinion. Do you have suggestions for improvements or have you found a bug? Get in touch at {email}.

Support.title: Support
Support.heading: How can we help?
Support.description: Have you found a technical fault, or do you have trouble logging in or uploading photos? We are happy to help.
Support.contactDescription: Describe your problem as clearly as possible. Get in touch at {email}.

SpexPicker.noneHint: E.g. a jubilee or FGV's annual meeting. Give a title.
SpexPicker.search: Search spex by title or year
SpexPicker.hint: Revivals are shown under their original spex. Title and year are taken from the spex unless you give others.
SpexPicker.mainHint: The main spex comes first: the category and the default title and year come from it.

content.title: Log in to see this
content.text: If it exists, it is for members only. Log in with your FGV account to see it.
content.noAccessText: It does not exist, or your FGV account has no access to it. Ask an administrator for access to Spexgram.

page.title: Members only
page.text: This page is for members. Log in with your FGV account to continue.
page.noAccessTitle: You have no access to Spexgram
page.noAccessText: This page is for members, and your FGV account has no access to Spexgram. Ask an administrator for access.

Home.title: Welcome to Spexgram
Home.intro: Photos and short videos from the spex, sorted in albums. Browse, search, and add your own photos to an album.
Home.introVisitor: Photos and short videos from the spex through the years. What is public is shown here; log in with your FGV account to see more.
Home.thisDayText: Photos and videos taken on today's date in earlier years.

Albums.count: {count, plural, =0 {No albums} one {# album} other {# albums}}
Albums.noneVisitor: No public albums match. Log in to see more.

Album.itemCount: {count, plural, =0 {no items} one {# photo or video} other {# photos and videos}}
Album.emptyText: There are no photos or videos here that you can see yet.
Album.emptyContribute: Do you have photos from this? Add them with the button above.

Report.title: Report the photo or video
Report.text: Tell us why it should be removed or corrected. An editor looks at it and answers.

reasons.I_AM_IN_IT: I am in it and want it removed

Report.hiddenAtOnce: It is hidden at once until an editor has looked at the report.
Report.emailHint: For the answer. It is kept with the report only.
Report.turnstileMissing: Reports from visitors cannot be sent right now.
Report.turnstileFailed: The check failed. Reload the page and try again.
Report.sent: Thank you! The report has been sent.
Report.sentHidden: Thank you! The report has been sent and the item is hidden until it has been handled.

Contribute.title: Add your photos to {album}
Contribute.text: Drag photos and short videos here, or choose them. They are shown to others once an editor has reviewed them. The photographer is your name unless another is given.
Contribute.limits: You can add at most {items} files or {gb} GB a day.
Contribute.closed: The album does not take contributions.

Contributions.title: My contributions
Contributions.text: Photos and videos you have added to albums. While they wait for review you can withdraw them. You get an email when they have been reviewed.
Contributions.noneText: Open an album and choose Add your photos.

Suggestions.title: Suggest an album
Suggestions.text: Is an album missing for something that was photographed? Suggest it, and add your photos at once. It is shown to others once an editor has accepted it.
Suggestions.sent: The suggestion has been sent. Add your photos!

MyReports.title: My reports
MyReports.text: Photos and videos you have reported and how the reports were handled.
MyReports.noneText: Report a photo from the viewer or its page.

Search.title: Search
Search.emptyText: Type a word of at least two characters and press Search.
Search.textHint: Searches album titles, places and descriptions, captions and photographers.
Search.smartHint: Searches what the photos show, e.g. “stage with smoke”, and can be narrowed with the filters.
Search.loginForMore: Log in to search everything and by content.
Search.items: {count, plural, one {# photo or video} other {# photos and videos}}

Map.title: Map
Map.text: Photos and videos with a position. Click a marker to see the photos there.
Map.count: {count, plural, one {# photo with a position} other {# photos with a position}}
Map.emptyDescription: No photos you can see have a position, or positions are not shown right now.

Spex.title: Spex
Spex.text: The albums of the spex and its revivals, oldest first.

ManageAlbum.newText: Choose the spex (or none), kind and date. New albums are unpublished until you change the visibility.
ManageAlbum.title: Title
ManageAlbum.titlePlaceholder: Default: the spex's title and year and the kind
ManageAlbum.dateToHint: For a period, e.g. a tour.
ManageAlbum.spexOrNone: Choose a spex, or mark that the album is about no spex.
ManageAlbum.titleRequired: An album without a spex needs a title.
ManageAlbum.dateOrder: The end date is before the start date.

ManageAlbum.trashText: The album and its photos and videos go to the trash and are not shown to anyone.

ManageAlbum.trashTitle: Move the album to the trash?
ManageAlbum.trashed: The album is in the trash

VisibilityControl.title: Visibility

describe.MEMBERS: Everyone with access to Spexgram sees the album.
describe.PUBLIC: Everyone sees the album, also visitors who are not logged in. Only items that are public themselves are shown to them.

VisibilityControl.items: Also set the album's {count, plural, one {# photo or video} other {# photos and videos}} to the same visibility
VisibilityControl.counts: The items themselves: {unpublished} unpublished, {members} for members, {public} public.
VisibilityControl.confirmPublic: The album becomes visible to everyone, also visitors who are not logged in, with {count, plural, =0 {no photos or videos} one {# photo or video} other {# photos and videos}}.
VisibilityControl.confirmMembers: The album becomes visible to everyone with access to Spexgram, but not to visitors.
VisibilityControl.confirmUnpublished: The album is hidden from everyone but editors.
VisibilityControl.confirmItems: All {count} photos and videos get the same visibility.
VisibilityControl.skipped: {count, plural, one {# photo or video} other {# photos and videos}} kept their visibility, since an open report hides them.

Review.title: Review contributions
Review.text: Members' contributions and album suggestions. Accepted contributions become items for members; rejected ones are deleted at once. The contributors get an email, at most once a day.
Review.suggestions: {count, plural, =0 {Album suggestions} one {# album suggestion} other {# album suggestions}}
Review.rejectTitle: Reject {count, plural, one {the contribution} other {# contributions}}?
Review.rejectText: The files are deleted at once.
Review.rejectSuggestionText: The album is deleted with its contributions.
Review.accepted: {count, plural, one {The contribution has been accepted} other {# contributions have been accepted}}
Review.rejected: {count, plural, one {The contribution has been rejected} other {# contributions have been rejected}}
Review.suggestionAccepted: The suggestion has been accepted and the album published for members

ManageReports.title: Reports
ManageReports.text: Reports of the kind “I am in it” hide the item at once until handled. The reporter gets the answer by email.

defaultMessage.KEPT: We have looked at the item and are keeping it.

Unsorted.title: Unsorted
Unsorted.text: Photos and videos in the photo store that belong to no album, e.g. from a bulk import, grouped by day. Select them and move them to an album.

Trash.title: Trash
Trash.text: Albums, photos and videos in the trash are not shown to anyone. Restore them here; an administrator can delete them for good.
Trash.textAdmin: Albums, photos and videos in the trash are not shown to anyone. Deleting removes the files from the photo store for good.
Trash.deleteKeep: Delete the album, keep the items
Trash.confirmDeleteAlbumText: The album is deleted with all its photos and videos and their files.
Trash.confirmDeleteKeep: Delete the album {title} but keep the items?
Trash.confirmDeleteKeepText: The photos and videos become unsorted.
Trash.confirmDeleteItemText: The file is deleted from the photo store.
Trash.confirmEmptyText: {albums} albums and {items} photos and videos are deleted with their files for good.

Audit.title: Change log
Audit.text: Your own changes to the archive.
Audit.textAdmin: All changes to the archive and the settings.
Audit.count: {count, plural, =0 {No changes} one {# change} other {# changes}}
Audit.oneRecord: Showing the changes of one record.
Audit.noneText: Changes show up here as they are made.
Audit.pickEnd: Pick the last day, or close to see up to today.

AdminSettings.title: Settings
AdminSettings.userDownloadsOriginals: Members may download originals and whole albums
AdminSettings.userDownloadsOriginalsText: Editors and admins always may. Videos are downloadable only when originals are.
AdminSettings.showPositionsText: With the items and on the map. Visitors never see positions.

AdminKinds.title: Album kinds
AdminKinds.text: The kinds an album can have, e.g. show, rehearsal or party. The first is the default for new albums. A kind that an album has, also in the trash, cannot be deleted.

AdminMaintenance.title: Maintenance
AdminMaintenance.text: The jobs the server runs on a schedule, in Swedish time. You can also start one now.
AdminMaintenance.started: {job} has started. It runs in the background.

SPEX_REFRESH.title: Spex refresh
SPEX_REFRESH.description: Copies the current titles, years and categories of the spex from Spexregister.

UNSORTED_SCAN.title: Unsorted scan
UNSORTED_SCAN.description: Lists photos and videos in the photo store that Spexgram does not know as unsorted.

PROCESSING_POLL.title: Processing
PROCESSING_POLL.description: Follows the photos and videos the photo store is processing.

ITEM_CHECK.title: File check
ITEM_CHECK.description: Checks that every photo and video is still in the photo store.

UPLOAD_CLEANUP.title: Upload cleanup
UPLOAD_CLEANUP.description: Removes uploads that were started but never used.

RETENTION.title: Retention
RETENTION.description: Deletes people, reports and reviews past their retention.

CONTRIBUTION_MAIL.title: Review emails
CONTRIBUTION_MAIL.description: Tells contributors that their contributions have been reviewed.

AdminImmich.title: Photo store (Immich)
AdminImmich.text: Immich stores and processes the files. Its version, queues and disk space are shown here, and items whose processing failed.
AdminImmich.unavailable: The server cannot reach Immich right now. Photos are shown as placeholders and uploads are refused.
AdminImmich.runFor: Run for {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
AdminImmich.started: The job has started in Immich
